Error.description: The request failed. The body carries a stable error code.

AccountSettings.description: Hub policy; this is never written into an official WeChat profile.

autoDownloadMaxBytes.description:
Largest advertised size in bytes that the daemon downloads automatically for this account,
from 0 to 536870912. Thumbnails and voice notes are always downloaded, and 0 limits
automatic downloads to those; the default is 52428800.

ApiError.description: The body of every failed request.

CallAudioFormat.description:
The PCM format of call audio. The daemon currently supports only 16,000 Hz,
mono, 20 ms frames.

frameMs.description: Length of one audio frame in milliseconds.

CallCapabilities.description: Calling operations that are available. A missing flag means unavailable.

conferenceAudio.description: Audio in conference calls is available.

conferenceCreate.description: Starting a conference call in a group is available.

conferenceInvite.description: Inviting more contacts into a connected conference call is available.

conferenceJoin.description: Joining a conference call from an invitation is available.

conferenceVideo.description: Video in conference calls is available. This version never sets it.

directAudio.description: Direct voice calls with one contact are available.

directVideo.description: Direct video calls are available. This version never sets it.

CallConferenceInvitation.description: A conference call this account can join. It carries no room credentials.

groupId.description: The group the conference call is in.

invitationId.description: Opaque ID for this account. Send it in `call.join`.

revision.description: Revision of the invitation. Send it in `call.join` exactly as listed.

CallControl.description:
A control a call participant can report. A microphone update does not
change the audio format.

muted.description: True when the microphone is muted.

CallDirection.description: Whether this account placed the call or received it.

oneOf.description: Another party called this account.
This account placed the call.

CallKind.description: Whether a call is with one contact or with a group.

oneOf.description: A call with one contact.
A call in a group.

CallMembership.description: Whether a participant is in a conference call.

oneOf.description: In the room.
Invited but not in the room.
Was in the room and left.
The server has not said.

CallOffer.description: An incoming call that can be answered or rejected now.

callType.description: Whether the call is voice or video.

kind.description: Whether the call is direct or a conference.

revision.description:
Increases when the offer changes. Send the latest value as
`expectedRevision` when answering or rejecting.

CallParticipant.description: One participant in a conference call.

membership.description: Whether the participant is in the room.

microphoneEnabled.description:
Whether the participant's microphone is on. Omitted until the server
reports it; an omitted value is unknown, not false.

participantId.description:
ID of the participant within this call. It is not a contact ID; use it
to match audio tracks to participants.

status.description: Signaling progress, separate from membership. Omitted until reported.

CallParticipantControl.description: A control reported by one participant.

participantId.description:
The participant the control belongs to. In a direct call this is the
contact ID.

CallParticipantStatus.description: Signaling progress of a participant, independent of membership.

code.description:
The status number the service reported. Keep it for codes `kind` does
not name.

CallParticipantStatusKind.description:
What a participant status code means. Cancelled, busy, rejected and no
response do not by themselves mean a participant left.

oneOf.description: Code 0: no state reported.
Code 1: in the room.
Code 2: invited, not in the room.
Code 3: invited and acknowledged, not in the room.
Code 4: left the room.
Code 5: cancelled.
Code 6: busy.
Code 7: rejected.
Code 8: no response.
Any other code. No join or departure is implied.

CallPendingOffer.description:
An incoming call that cannot be answered yet, because it is waiting for a
ready client or for the daemon to finish preparing it.

callType.description: Whether the call is voice or video.

kind.description: Whether the call is direct or a conference.

phase.description: What the call is waiting for.

CallPendingPhase.description: How far along an incoming call is before it can be answered.

oneOf.description: Waiting for a client to advertise readiness.
The daemon is preparing the call.

CallSnapshot.description:
The state of calling for one account, as returned by the HTTP snapshot
route. The `hello` event carries the same fields.

audioFormat.description: The PCM format used for call audio.

availability.description: Whether this account is in a call.

conferenceInvitations.description: Conference calls this account can join.

currentOffer.description: The incoming call that can be answered now, or null.

currentPendingOffer.description: An incoming call that cannot be answered yet, or null.

CallState.description:
Where a call is in its life. Stop sending audio at `ending`, and keep the
control socket connected while the daemon finishes cleanup.

oneOf.description: An incoming call is waiting to be answered or rejected.
An outgoing call is being placed.
The other side is ringing.
The call was accepted and audio is being set up.
The call is up and audio can flow.
The call is being hung up.
The call is over.
The outcome could not be confirmed.

CallType.description:
Whether a call is voice or video, independent of the media currently
negotiated. A video call can continue with audio only. This daemon places
and answers voice calls only.

oneOf.description: A voice call.
A video call.

CallView.description: A call this account is in.

callType.description: Whether the call is voice or video.

controls.description:
The latest controls reported by the other party of a direct call, also
given to a newly connected observer. Omitted until one is reported.

direction.description: Whether this account placed the call or received it.

groupId.description: The group of a conference call. Omitted for a direct call.

kind.description: Whether the call is direct or a conference.

ownedByThisClient.description: True when this connection owns the call. Always false in HTTP snapshots.

participants.description: The latest conference roster. Omitted for a direct call.

revision.description:
Increases each time the call changes. Send the latest value as
`expectedRevision`.

state.description: Where the call is in its life.

CallsAvailability.description: Whether this account is in a call.

busy.description:
True while this account has a call, including one whose outcome is
unresolved, so a new call cannot start.

ownedByThisClient.description: True when this connection owns that call.

ContactLookupRequest.description: Request to look up several contacts.

representation.description: The file itself or its preview. Defaults to the original.

ContentRepresentation.description: Which bytes of a media asset to return.

oneOf.description: The file itself.
The saved preview of the file.

CreateAccountRequest.description: Request to register a new account.

alias.description: A friendly name that can be used in place of the ID.

id.description: Account ID. Omit it and the daemon generates one.

EventAckRequest.description: Request to record how far a consumer has read the events.

cursor.description: The cursor of the last event the consumer has handled, a decimal string.

EventQuery.description: Options for reading the event log or stream.

after.description: Return events after this cursor, a decimal string. Defaults to 0, the start.

limit.description: Events per JSON page. Defaults to 100. The stream ignores it.

GroupMutationKeyQuery.description: Options for finding a group change by its idempotency key.

key.description: The `Idempotency-Key` the group change was submitted with.

LinkCard.description: Details of a shared link, article, music or video card, or a Channels post.

description.description: Card description or summary. Null when there is none.

sourceName.description:
Name of the site or account that published the card, such as a Channels account. Null when
there is none.

title.description: Card title. Null when there is none.

url.description:
Address the card opens. Null when the card has none or it is not a valid http or https
address.

LocationCard.description: A static location pin. No map service is contacted and the coordinates are not converted.

address.description: Address text supplied with the pin. Null when there is none.

coordinateSystem.description:
Coordinate system of the numbers. It is always `unknown`, because coordinates are reported
as sent.

mapType.description: Map type text supplied with the pin, as sent. Null when there is none.

name.description: Place name supplied with the pin. Null when there is none.

poiId.description: Place identifier supplied with the pin, as sent. Null when there is none.

scale.description: Map scale value supplied with the pin, as sent. Null when there is none.

LocationCoordinateSystem.description: Coordinate system of a location pin's latitude and longitude.

LoginRequest.description: Options for signing an account in. Every field is optional.

allowQr.description:
Whether a QR code may be shown. When false, only a saved login can be used. The default is
true.

computerName.description:
Name this computer gives WeChat while signing in, up to 100 characters. The default is
`agent-wechat`.

forceQr.description:
True to skip the saved login and use a QR code, the same as strategy `qr`. The default is
false.

qrRefresh.description: How an expired QR code is replaced.

strategy.description: How to sign in. The default is `auto`.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the sign-in to finish, from 10 to 900 seconds. The default is 300.

oneOf.description:
Use the saved login if there is one, and fall back to a QR code if it is missing or
rejected.

Use only the saved login. If it cannot be used, the attempt ends as `needs_login` without
showing a QR code.
Always sign in by scanning a QR code.

MediaAsset.description: One copy of a message's attachment, and whether its bytes have been downloaded and checked.

accountId.description: ID of the account the attachment belongs to.

actualVariant.description: Which copy the cached bytes really are, once checked. Null until bytes are cached.

advertisedByteLength.description:
Size in bytes the sender advertised, which can differ from the checked size. Omitted when
the sender gave none, which does not mean the file is empty.

animationFrames.description: Number of frames when the attachment is an animated image. Null otherwise.

autoDownloadAllowed.description:
True when the account's current download setting allows this copy to be downloaded
automatically.

byteLength.description: Size in bytes of the cached bytes that were checked. Null until they are cached.

contentType.description: MIME type of the cached bytes. Null until they are cached.

contentUrl.description: Path on the daemon to fetch the cached bytes from. Null until the attachment is available.

expiresAt.description: When WeChat's copy expires, as Unix time in seconds. Null when WeChat gave no expiry.

filename.description: File name of the attachment, when it has one. Null otherwise.

id.description: Attachment ID, used to fetch or request this copy.

jobId.description: ID of the job downloading or sending this attachment. Null when there is none.

kind.description: What kind of attachment this is.

messageId.description: ID of the message the attachment belongs to. Null when it is not tied to a message.

officialWriteback.description:
Whether the downloaded copy was also saved into the official profile's own media folders:
`complete`, `pending`, `blocked`, or `unsupported` for media that is never saved there.

reason.description:
Machine-readable code explaining the state, such as `media_expired`. Null when there is
nothing to explain.

retryable.description: True when asking for the download again can still succeed.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the cached bytes, as lowercase hex. Null until they are cached.

state.description:
`pending` (not downloaded yet), `available` (downloaded and checked), `expired` (WeChat no
longer has it) or `unsupported`.

variant.description: Which copy this is, as advertised by the message.

MediaImagePreview.description: A separately hashed still image. Its bytes never replace the source asset.

byteLength.description: Size of the preview in bytes.

contentUrl.description: Path on the daemon to fetch the preview from.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the preview bytes, as lowercase hex.

sourceSha256.description: SHA-256 of the original image bytes this preview was made from.

MediaJob.description: A background upload or download of media, with its progress. Poll it by ID until it finishes.

accountId.description: ID of the account the job belongs to.

assetId.description: ID of the attachment being downloaded. Null for sends.

attempts.description:
How many times the job has been started. A failed job can be retried only while this is
below 3.

cancelRequested.description: True when a cancel has been requested for the job.

createdAt.description: When the job was created, as an RFC 3339 time.

kind.description: `send` for an upload to a chat, or `download` for fetching a received attachment.

reason.description: Error code of the last failure. Null when there has been none.

result.description:
Details of the outcome. Its fields depend on the job, and it is null until there is
something to report.

retryable.description: True when the job can be retried.

serverMessageId.description: WeChat's ID of the sent message once WeChat accepted it. Null until then.

sourceId.description: ID of the uploaded source being sent. Null for downloads.

state.description:
Where the job stands: `queued`, `running`, `available` (download finished), `accepted`
(WeChat took the send), `needs_review` (the outcome is unknown, so check before sending
again), `cancelled`, `expired`, `unsupported` or `failed`.

threadId.description: ID of the chat a send goes to. Null for downloads.

totalBytes.description: Total bytes to transfer, when known. Null otherwise.

updatedAt.description: When the job last changed, as an RFC 3339 time.

oneOf.description: A photo or other still image.
Any file. A file is sent with its bytes unchanged.
A video.
A voice note.
A sticker. Stickers can be received and downloaded but not sent.

MediaQuery.description: Options for fetching a saved image.

MediaSendRequest.description:
Request to send an uploaded file, image, video or voice note. Upload the bytes first, then send
with the returned source ID.

durationMs.description:
Length of a voice note in milliseconds. Optional, because the daemon measures the audio
itself.

kind.description: What to send. Stickers cannot be sent.

playSeconds.description:
Length of a video in seconds, from 1 to 3600. Optional, because the daemon measures the
video itself.

sourceId.description: ID of the uploaded source to send, as returned by the upload route.

standardSourceId.description:
ID of an uploaded JPEG to use as the standard-size copy of an image instead of generating
one. Only valid for image sends.

threadId.description: ID of the chat to send to.

thumbnailSourceId.description:
ID of an uploaded JPEG to use as the thumbnail instead of generating one. Only valid for
image and video sends.

videoQuality.description: How to send a video, `normal` by default or `original`. Only valid for video sends.

MediaTransferRequest.description: Request to download an attachment of a message.

assetId.description:
ID of the specific attachment to download. When null, the daemon picks the attachment that
matches `quality`.

messageId.description: ID of the message to download from. It must match the message ID in the URL.

quality.description: Which copy to download. The default is `best`.

MediaVariant.description:
Which copy of an attachment, or which quality to request. For a request, `best` picks the best
copy available.

oneOf.description: The best copy available. It downloads one when none is cached. Only valid in a request.
A small preview copy.
The standard-size copy of an image.

The original copy as offered by the sender, which can be smaller than the sender's own
source.
The ordinary playback copy of a video, or the playable audio of a voice note.
A voice note in its original encoded form.

MiniProgramCard.description: Public display and routing metadata derived from a saved Mini Program card.

displayName.description: Program name, when supplied by the card.

pagePath.description: Page route and query carried in the card.

accountId.description: ID of the account that was removed.

filesRetained.description: True when the account's local files were kept. They are always kept.

removed.description: True when the account was removed.

NativeAccountRemovalRequest.description: Request to remove a signed-out account.

confirmAccountId.description: Must repeat the account ID from the URL, to confirm the removal.

NativeContact.description: A contact saved in the account's profile.

alias.description: The custom WeChat ID the contact chose, which they can change. Null when none is saved.

displayName.description: Name to show: the remark if set, else the nickname, else the username.

id.description: Contact ID. It is the same as `username`.

nickname.description: The name the contact chose for themselves. Null when none is saved.

relation.description:
Relationship to this account. It currently always reports `unknown`, including for saved
friends.

remark.description: Your private name for the contact. Null when none is saved.

NativeContactPage.description:
One page of a list. `items` holds the resources, `nextCursor` continues the list, and the other
fields describe the saved data the list was read from.

asOfEventCursor.description:
Event cursor that was current when the list was first read. Resume the event stream from it
to catch changes made after the read.

coverage.description:
Which saved databases the read covered, as `partial` (true when some could not be read) and
`databases` (each one with its state). It describes local data, not completeness on WeChat's
servers.

items.description: The entries on this page, in list order.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` with the same query to get the next page. Null on the last page.

sourceGeneration.description:
Fingerprint of the saved profile data the page was read from. It changes when the profile
files change.

NativeEvent.description: An entry in the account's event log, which keeps only about the most recent 10,000 events.

createdAt.description: When the event was recorded, as an RFC 3339 time.

cursor.description:
Position of the event in the log, a decimal number written as a string that only increases.
Pass the last one you handled as `after` to resume.

data.description:
Details of the event. The fields depend on `kind`; for example `message.committed` carries
`messageId` and `threadId`.

kind.description:
Kind of event, such as `message.committed`, `thread.updated`, `group.updated`,
`operation.updated` or `send.updated`.

NativeForgetRequest.description: Request to delete the account's saved login credentials.

confirm.description: Must be true. It confirms that the credentials should be deleted.

NativeGroup.description: A group chat saved in the account's profile.

administratorIds.description:
IDs of the group's administrators. The owner is not listed unless WeChat lists them too, and
the field is null when the saved data cannot say.

announcement.description: Text of the group's current announcement. Null when there is none.

canMentionAll.description:
Whether this account may mention everyone: true for the owner and administrators and false
for other members. Null means permission is not established, and older servers omit the
field.

displayName.description: Name to show for the group: your remark if set, else the group's name, else the ID.

id.description: Group ID, ending with `@chatroom`. It is the same as `roomId`.

isInGroup.description:
True when this account is still a member of the group and false when it is not. Null when
the saved data does not say.

minimized.description:
True when the group is minimized (folded) in the chat list and false when it is not. Null
when the saved data does not say.

muted.description:
True when notifications for the group are muted and false when they are on. Null when the
saved data does not say.

myDisplayName.description: This account's own display name in the group. Null or omitted when it is not known.

name.description: The group's own shared name. Null when none is saved.

ownerId.description: ID of the member who owns the group. Null when the saved data does not say.

remark.description: Your private name for the group. Null when none is saved.

NativeGroupCreateRequest.description: Request to create a group chat.

members.description: IDs of the contacts to add, from 2 to 40, without repeats and without this account's own ID.

name.description: Name for the new group, up to 512 bytes. Optional.

NativeGroupMember.description: A member of a group, as saved in the account's profile.

displayName.description:
Name to show for the member: your remark, else their name in this group, else their
nickname, else their username.

id.description: Member ID. It is the same as `username`.

mentionName.description:
Name used for this member in mention text. It comes from their name in the group or their
nickname, never from your private remark, and falls back to the username.

roomDisplayName.description: The member's own display name in this group. Null when none is saved.

NativeGroupMemberLookup.description: Result of looking up one person in a group's saved member list.

coverage.description: How the answer was obtained. It is currently always `cached`, meaning saved data only.

groupId.description: ID of the group that was searched.

member.description: The member's details when `state` is `present`, otherwise null.

state.description:
`present` when the person is in the saved member list and `unconfirmed` when they are not. A
missing row does not prove they left, because the saved list can be incomplete.

coverage.description:

items.description: The entries on this page, in list order.

sourceGeneration.description:

NativeGroupMembersRequest.description: Members to add to or remove from a group.

members.description: IDs of the contacts, from 1 to 40, without repeats and without this account's own ID.

NativeGroupMyNameRequest.description: Request to change this account's display name in a group.

displayName.description: The new display name, up to 512 bytes.

name.description: The new group name. It must not be blank and can be up to 512 bytes.

NativeGroupPage.description:
One page of a list. `items` holds the resources, `nextCursor` continues the list, and the other

asOfEventCursor.description:
Event cursor that was current when the list was first read. Resume the event stream from it

coverage.description:
Which saved databases the read covered, as `partial` (true when some could not be read) and

NativeIdentity.description: Which daemon is running and what it supports.

apiVersion.description: Version of this HTTP API, currently 1.

capabilities.description: Names of the features this daemon supports, such as `text-send` and `events`.

target.description:
Platform the daemon was built for, as a Rust target triple such as
`x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`.

items.description: One entry for each requested message.

NativeMediaBatchItem.description: The attachments found for one message.

assets.description: Attachments of the message. Empty when `error` is set.

error.description: Error code when this message's attachments could not be listed, otherwise null.

messageId.description: ID of the message that was looked up.

NativeMediaBatchRequest.description: Messages whose attachments to list without downloading anything.

messageIds.description: IDs of the messages to look up, from 1 to 40 per request.

NativeMediaJobRetryRequest.description: Options for retrying a media job.

reuseCompletedUpload.description:
True to reuse the upload a send job already finished instead of uploading again. The
retry-completed-upload route requires true here.

NativeMediaWritebackRequest.description:
Request to repair saved media records from bytes the daemon already holds. It never downloads or
sends anything.

limit.description: How many saved media records to repair in this request, from 1 to 100.

NativeMentions.description: Who a message mentions, read from the mention list saved with the message.

all.description:
True when the message mentions everyone, false when it does not, and null when the mentions
are unknown.

self.description:
True when this account is among the mentioned members, false when it is not, and null when
the mentions are unknown.

source.description:
Where the mentions were read from, currently `msgsource.atuserlist`. Null when there is no
source, for example when `state` is `unknown`.

state.description:
`known` when the mention list was read, `unknown` when it is missing or cannot be parsed.
When unknown, `userIds` is empty and the flags are null.

userIds.description: IDs of the members mentioned by name, not counting the mention-everyone marker (see `all`).

NativeMessage.description:
A saved message as read from the account's profile. It carries only readable fields and never
raw message XML.

accountId.description: ID of the account the message belongs to.

appMessageType.description:
For app messages (type 49), the app subtype, such as 5 link, 6 file, 8 shared sticker, 19
forwarded chat and 57 quote reply. Null for other messages.

body.description:
Readable text of the message, such as the text itself or a summary of a link, location or
forwarded chat. Null when there is nothing readable, for example for a photo.

createdAt.description: When the message was created, as an RFC 3339 time. Null when the saved time is missing.

direction.description:
`outgoing` when this account sent the message and `incoming` when someone else did. Null for
system notices and when it cannot be determined.

id.description: Message ID. Pass it back unchanged to routes that take a message ID.

link.description:
Link card details when the message is a shared link, article, music or video card, or a
Channels post. Null otherwise.

location.description: Pin details when the message is a static location. Omitted for other messages.

media.description: Always an empty list today. Use the message's media routes to list its attachments.

miniProgram.description: Mini Program card read from the saved message.

quote.description: The message this one replies to, when it is a quote reply. Null otherwise.

recall.description:
Recall details. Present only when the message was recalled, in which case `body` is
`[Message recalled]`.

senderId.description: ID of the sender. Null for system notices and when the sender cannot be determined.

serverId.description:
WeChat's own ID for the message, as a string because it can exceed the largest whole number
JavaScript holds exactly. Null when the saved message has none.

threadId.description: ID of the chat the message is in.

type.description:
WeChat's numeric message type, such as 1 text, 3 image, 34 voice, 43 video, 47 sticker, 48
location, 49 app message (links, files, quotes) and 10000 system notice.

version.description:
Fingerprint of the saved profile data this message was read from. It changes whenever the
profile files change, not only when this message changes.

NativeMessagePage.description:
One page of a list. `items` holds the resources, `nextCursor` continues the list, and the other
fields describe the saved data the list was read from.

asOfEventCursor.description:
Event cursor that was current when the list was first read. Resume the event stream from it
to catch changes made after the read.

coverage.description:
Which saved databases the read covered, as `partial` (true when some could not be read) and
`databases` (each one with its state). It describes local data, not completeness on WeChat's
servers.

items.description: The entries on this page, in list order.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` with the same query to get the next page. Null on the last page.

sourceGeneration.description:
Fingerprint of the saved profile data the page was read from. It changes when the profile
files change.

NativeMiniProgram.description: A Mini Program known to the selected account.

available.description: Whether the hub has a staged package for this program.

title.description: Name shown in the known-app list.

NativeMiniProgramCapabilities.description: Account and app permissions available to the local runner for this launch.

login.description: Whether the runner may request app login codes.

shareToChat.description: Whether this launch can share its current page to a chat.

NativeMiniProgramEntry.description: Compiled entry page selected for a Mini Program launch.

framework.description: Compiled component framework selected by the runner.

query.description: Query string of the shared entry, without its leading question mark.

renderer.description: Renderer used by the local runner.

servicePath.description: Archive path of the compiled page's service module.

NativeMiniProgramIpcRequest.description: A hub operation requested by a running Mini Program.

NativeMiniProgramLaunch.description: Package and entry selection for one Mini Program launch.

capabilities.description: Operations the runner can request for this launch.

entry.description: Page selected for the local runner.

launchId.description: Temporary launch ID bound to the initiating account and token.

networkPolicy.description: Current server policy, or null when the account is offline.

packages.description: Verified archives to download before execution.

NativeMiniProgramLaunchRequest.description: Select a default entry or resolve a saved card on the selected account.

sourceMessageId.description: Saved card message ID. Omit to use the program's default page.

NativeMiniProgramLogin.description: Temporary app-specific code returned to the authorized local runner.

code.description: WeChat code for the selected app's backend. Treat it as sensitive.

NativeMiniProgramNetworkPolicy.description: Server-provided request policy for the selected Mini Program.

requestDomains.description: Domain patterns used by the host's request-domain check.

NativeMiniProgramPackage.description: One verified archive selected for a Mini Program launch.

id.description: Package ID to use when downloading this archive.

root.description: Declared root for a cached subpackage. Omitted for the main archive.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original archive, in lowercase hex.

sizeBytes.description: Byte length of the original archive.

NativeMiniPrograms.description: Mini Programs known from recent saved cards and the selected account's cache.

items.description: Known apps and their package availability.

NativeOperation.description:
A background operation such as signing in or out, refreshing contacts or changing a group. Poll
it by ID until it finishes.

accountId.description: ID of the account the operation belongs to.

createdAt.description: When the operation was created, as an RFC 3339 time.

kind.description:
What the operation does, such as `login`, `logout`, `sync`, `metadata`, `group_mutation`,
`message_recall` or `media-writeback`.

result.description:
Details of the outcome. Its fields depend on `kind`, and it is empty until the operation has
something to report.

state.description:
Where the operation stands, such as `queued`, `running`, `succeeded`, `failed` or
`cancelled`. Some kinds report more states, for example `needs_review`, or `awaiting_scan`
and `awaiting_approval` during a login.

updatedAt.description: When the operation last changed, as an RFC 3339 time.

NativePageItemOfNativeContact.description:
One entry on a page: the resource itself, or a tombstone when the resource has been removed
since the list was first read.

NativePageItemOfNativeGroup.description:
One entry on a page: the resource itself, or a tombstone when the resource has been removed
since the list was first read.

NativePageItemOfNativeGroupMember.description:
One entry on a page: the resource itself, or a tombstone when the resource has been removed
since the list was first read.

NativePageItemOfNativeMessage.description:
One entry on a page: the resource itself, or a tombstone when the resource has been removed
since the list was first read.

NativePageItemOfNativeThread.description:
One entry on a page: the resource itself, or a tombstone when the resource has been removed
since the list was first read.

NativeQuoteReference.description:
The message a quote reply refers to. Its content comes only from the excerpt carried inside the
reply, never from a saved copy of the original.

appMessageType.description:
App subtype of the quoted message when it is an app message (type 49), such as 5 for a link.
Null for other messages.

direction.description:
`outgoing` when the quoted message was sent by this account and `incoming` when someone else
sent it. Null when that cannot be told.

embeddedImage.description:
True when the reply carries the quoted image, so it can be downloaded through the reply's
media routes.

embeddedLink.description:
Link card of the quoted message when it was a shared link, with the same fields as `link` on
a message.

embeddedMiniProgram.description: Mini Program metadata retained by the reply.

embeddedSticker.description: True when the quoted message is a sticker. Omitted otherwise.

embeddedText.description: Readable text of the quoted message, taken from the reply. Null when there is none.

senderId.description: ID of the quoted message's sender, when the reply says who it was.

senderName.description: Sender's display name carried inside the reply, when supplied by WeChat.

serverId.description: WeChat's ID of the quoted message, as a string.

state.description:
How much of the quote could be shown: `embedded` when the reply carries readable content,
`missing` when it carries none, `unsupported` for a kind of message that cannot be shown as
a quote, and `recalled` when the original was recalled and its content is hidden.

type.description: WeChat's numeric type of the quoted message, with the same values as `type` on a message.

NativeReadRequest.description: Request to mark a chat as read.

expectedVersion.description:
The chat's `readStateVersion` from when you read it. The request is refused if the chat has
changed since.

observedAt.description: When the daemon first saw the recall, as an RFC 3339 time.

recalledAt.description:
When WeChat says the message was recalled, as an RFC 3339 time. Omitted when that time is
not known.

replacementText.description: The notice text WeChat saved in place of the message. Omitted or null when there is none.

NativeRecallRequest.description: Request to recall a message this account sent.

serverId.description:
The message's `serverId`, copied as a string. The recall is refused if it does not match the
message in the URL.

NativeSendIntent.description: A text or share-card send and how far it got. Media sends are reported as media jobs instead.

accountId.description: ID of the account that is sending.

clientId.description: ID the daemon gave the message when it submitted it to WeChat.

createdAt.description: When the send was created, as an RFC 3339 time.

destination.description: ID of the chat the message is sent to.

errorCode.description: Why the send failed or needs review. Null otherwise.

id.description: Send ID, used to look the send up or cancel it.

localMessageId.description:
ID of the saved message that represents this send, once it appears in the profile. Omitted
until then.

serverId.description: WeChat's ID of the message once it was accepted, as a string. Null until then.

state.description:
`queued`, `submitting`, `accepted` (WeChat took it), `failed` (WeChat refused it),
`needs_review` (the outcome is unknown, so check the chat before sending again) or
`cancelled`.

NativeStatus.description: Identity and state of the running daemon.

dataDir.description: Path of the data directory on the daemon's host.

ownershipGeneration.description: Random ID created each time the daemon starts. A shutdown request must repeat it.

serverId.description: ID of this daemon's data directory. It is created once and kept across restarts.

state.description: Daemon state. It is `ready` while the daemon is serving requests.

version.description: Identity and build of the daemon.

NativeTextSendRequest.description: Request to send a text message, optionally as a quote reply or with mentions.

mentions.description: Group members to mention. Only allowed when sending to a group.

quote.description: The saved message this text replies to. The token also needs the `read` scope.

text.description:
The message text. A quote reply can hold up to 16 KiB and other text up to 64 KiB, including
mention names.

threadId.description: ID of the chat to send to.

NativeThread.description:
A chat in the chat list: a direct chat, a group or a built-in chat such as File Transfer.
Summaries come from saved history and are not refreshed from WeChat.

accountId.description: ID of the account the chat belongs to.

avatarMembers.description:
Up to four cached group members, for drawing the group's picture. Empty for direct chats or
when the member list is unavailable.

displayName.description:
Name shown for the chat: your remark if set, else the contact's nickname or the group's
name, else the ID.

history.description:
How complete the saved history is. It currently always reports partial coverage and no local
message count.

id.description:
Chat ID. For a direct chat it is the contact's username, and for a group it ends with
`@chatroom`.

kind.description:
`direct` for a one-to-one chat, `group` for a group, and `system` for a built-in chat such
as File Transfer.

lastMessage.description:
Preview of the latest message. Omitted when local message data is unavailable, and null when
the chat has no messages.

muted.description:
Saved notification preference: true when the chat is muted and false when it is not. Null
means the profile cannot establish it.

peerId.description: ID of the person or group on the other side of the chat. It is the same as `id`.

pinned.description:
Saved pin preference: true when the chat is pinned and false when it is not. Null means the
profile cannot establish it.

readStateVersion.description:
Version of the chat's read state. Send it as `expectedVersion` when marking the chat read;
the request is refused if the chat changed since.

unreadCount.description: Number of unread messages as saved in the profile. Null when the saved data does not say.

NativeThreadAvatarMember.description: A group member shown in the group's picture.

displayName.description: Name to show for the member.

NativeThreadMessage.description: Preview of the latest message in a chat.

createdAt.description: When the message was created, as an RFC 3339 time. Null when unknown.

direction.description:
`outgoing` when this account sent the message and `incoming` when someone else did. Null
when it cannot be determined.

id.description: ID of the message, the same as `id` on the full message.

senderId.description: ID of the sender. Null for system notices and when the sender is unknown.

senderName.description:
Name of the sender, taken from the group's cached members or your contacts. Null when the
message has no sender or the name is unknown.

text.description:
Plain-text preview of up to 160 characters. Media messages use labels such as Photo and
Sticker, and a recalled message shows its recall notice.

type.description: WeChat's numeric message type, with the same values as `type` on a message.

NativeThreadNotificationsRequest.description: Request to mute or unmute notifications for a chat.

muted.description: True to mute the chat and false to turn its notifications back on.

NativeThreadPage.description:
One page of a list. `items` holds the resources, `nextCursor` continues the list, and the other
fields describe the saved data the list was read from.

asOfEventCursor.description:
Event cursor that was current when the list was first read. Resume the event stream from it
to catch changes made after the read.

coverage.description:
Which saved databases the read covered, as `partial` (true when some could not be read) and
`databases` (each one with its state). It describes local data, not completeness on WeChat's
servers.

items.description: The entries on this page, in list order.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` with the same query to get the next page. Null on the last page.

sourceGeneration.description:
Fingerprint of the saved profile data the page was read from. It changes when the profile
files change.

NativeThreadPinRequest.description: Request to pin or unpin a chat.

pinned.description: True to pin the chat and false to unpin it.

NativeTombstone.description:
Stands in for a resource that was in the list when it was first read but is no longer in the
saved profile. It keeps the resource's place in the list.

deleted.description: Always true, marking the resource as removed.

version.description:
Fingerprint of the saved profile data in which the resource is missing, the same value as
`sourceGeneration` on the page.

OfficialProfileRequest.description: Where to find the stopped official WeChat profile to attach as an account.

accountId.description:
ID of the account expected to own this profile. The request is refused if the profile is not
already attached to that account.

path.description:
Absolute path on the daemon's host to a home folder containing `xwechat_files`, to that
folder, or to one account's folder. When omitted, the daemon searches only its own home
folder.

OfficialProfileSelection.description: The account an official profile is attached to.

accountId.description: ID of the account that uses the profile.

profilePath.description: Path of the attached profile on the daemon's host.

savedDeviceLoginAvailable.description: True when the profile holds saved login details that can sign in without a QR code.

storageMode.description: `official`, meaning the profile is used in place and not copied.

OwnedMediaSource.description: A file uploaded to the daemon, ready to be sent.

byteLength.description: Size of the file in bytes.

createdAt.description: When the upload was stored, as an RFC 3339 time.

id.description: Source ID. Pass it as `sourceId` when sending.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes, as lowercase hex.

PageQuery.description: Paging and filter options for list routes.

cursor.description:
The `nextCursor` of the previous page, up to 8192 characters. Send it
with the same query.

kind.description: Only list chats of this kind: `direct`, `group` or `system`.

search.description: Text to search for, up to 256 characters. The name `query` is accepted too.

PeerApplication.description:
Reference to an account type for one language, from the saved WeCom application data. The label
of the account type is not included.

accountTypeCached.description:
True when the profile also holds the label for this account type and language. The label
itself is not returned.

accountTypeId.description: ID of the account type for this language. Null when none is saved.

languageId.description: The language this entry applies to, as the number WeChat stores.

PeerBusinessKind.description: Kind of business account, worked out from the numeric `businessType`.

oneOf.description: An official account (business type 0).
A service account (business type 1).
An enterprise account (business type 2).
An enterprise child account (business type 3).
A photo account (business type 5).

PeerCategory.description: What kind of peer this is. It is separate from the chat type and from whether the peer is in your contacts.

oneOf.description: No category is established. Do not assume a personal account or a friend.
A built-in peer such as File Transfer.
A group chat.
An official or business account.
A WeCom contact.
A WeCom customer-service identity.

PeerClassification.description:
What kind of peer this is, worked out from the saved profile each time it is read.
Missing details do not mean the peer is an ordinary person or that you are not subscribed to it.

businessType.description:
Numeric service type saved for a business account: 0 official account, 1 service account, 2
enterprise, 3 enterprise child, 5 photo account. Null for other peers and when the saved
values conflict.

openIm.description:
Saved WeCom details, present for `openim` and `openim_customer_service` peers when the
profile has them. Null otherwise.

PeerNamespace.description:
The family of IDs a peer's ID belongs to, worked out from the ID itself. It does not grant any
extra actions.

oneOf.description: An ordinary WeChat ID, including groups ending with `@chatroom`.
An ID containing `@openim`, a WeCom contact.
An ID containing `@kefu.openim`, a WeCom customer-service identity.
A group ID containing `@im.chatroom`.
An ID ending with `@qy_u` (a person) or `@qy_g` (a group).
An ID containing `@weclaw`.
Any other ID containing `@` that matches no known family.

PeerOpenIm.description: Saved WeCom (OpenIM) details for a peer.

appId.description: ID of the WeCom application the peer belongs to. Null when none is saved.

applications.description: Account type references, one per language.

wordingId.description: ID of the set of labels in `wordings`. Null when none is saved.

wordings.description: Localized labels for the peer, one per language.

languageId.description:
The language of the text, as the number WeChat stores. Choose the language to show in your
app.

QrQuery.description: Options for fetching a login QR code.

generation.description:
Only return the QR code if it is still this generation. A newer code
fails with `login_challenge_superseded`.

QrRefresh.description: How an expired QR code is replaced.

maxRefreshes.description: How many times to replace an expired QR code automatically, from 0 to 3. The default is 3.

mode.description:
Whether an expired QR code that nobody scanned is replaced automatically. The default is
`auto`.

QrRefreshMode.description: Whether an expired QR code is replaced automatically.

oneOf.description: Replace an expired, unscanned QR code with a new one, up to the refresh limit.
Do not replace it. An expired QR code ends the attempt as `expired`.

QuoteSendReference.description:
Identifies the saved message that a text reply quotes. The daemon reads the original itself, so
callers never supply its content.

messageId.description: ID of the saved message to quote, copied from `id` on the message.

serverId.description:
The quoted message's `serverId`, copied as a string. The request is refused if it does not
match the saved message.

RefreshAvatarRequest.description: Optional group context for an OpenIM member's avatar lookup.

roomId.description: Group containing this known member, when context is required by WeChat.

RoomQuery.description: Options for looking up one group.

version.description: The member-list version you already know. Defaults to 0.

SendKeyQuery.description: Options for finding a send by its idempotency key.

key.description: The `Idempotency-Key` the send was submitted with, up to 200 characters.

ShareSendRequest.description:
A share card to send: a link with a title, an optional description and an optional thumbnail
address. Nothing is fetched from the linked page.

description.description: Text shown under the title. Optional.

threadId.description: ID of the chat to send to.

thumbnailUrl.description:
Address of a preview image for the card. It must be an http or https address without a
port or fragment.

title.description: Card title. It must not be blank.

url.description: Address the card opens. It must be an http or https address.

TextMentionPosition.description: UTF-16 offsets into the submitted text, with an exclusive end.

end.description:
UTF-16 offset just past the end of the mention. The mention includes its closing space
character (U+2005).

index.description:
Which `userIds` entry this mention stands for, counting from 0. Use 0 when mentioning
everyone.

start.description: UTF-16 offset in the text where the mention starts, at the `@` character.

TextMentions.description: Which group members a text message mentions. Give either `userIds` or `all: true`, not both.

all.description: True to mention everyone. Only the group owner and administrators can do this.

positions.description:
Where each mention sits inside `text`, so it shows inline. Without positions the names are
placed before the text, and when given, every mentioned member needs at least one position.

userIds.description:
IDs of the members to mention, at most 128 and without repeats. Leave out when `all` is
true.

TokenRequest.description: Request to issue an API token.

accounts.description: Account IDs the token can use, or `*` for every account.

expiresAt.description: Unix time in seconds when the token stops working. Omit it for no expiry.

scopes.description: Scopes the token grants: `read`, `send`, `media`, `login`, `calls`, `admin` and so on.

autoConnect.description: Whether the account connects automatically when the daemon starts.

VideoSendQuality.description:
How a video is sent: `normal` sends a prepared playback copy and a thumbnail, and `original`
also includes the unchanged source video.

oneOf.description: Send a prepared playback copy and a thumbnail.
Also include the unchanged source video.

bearer.description: An API token sent as `Authorization: Bearer TOKEN`. The listed roles are token scopes, and `admin` passes every scope check. `owner` means only the owner token is accepted.
